pages.text: This is a Lizard! Lizards are known for being very cute and peaceful creatures. Kits usually like to hunt these down for fun.

pages.title: About the Lizard
pages.text: Lizards are very peaceful creatures that can be sometimes found around the world. $(br2)Lizards are usually the training prey for kits and apprentices, they are apparently fun to chase! $(br2)Lizards can be adopted if you give them Spider Eyes. Once tamed, they will dig items for you sometimes, and they can follow you, sit, or wander around. $(br2)You can even carry tamed Lizards on your head! $(br2)Lizards lay eggs once they find a mate. They will lay their eggs in dark places, and after some time, baby lizards will hatch! $(br)
